title: Portable Starter
config.size: config_starter.json is too large (1 MB at most).
config.syntax:
config_starter.json has an error in line %d, character %d.

Common causes:
• a comma after the last entry
• a missing quotation mark
• a single backslash – write \\ or /
config.key: config_starter.json: "%s" is unknown. Only "programme" is allowed.
config.list: config_starter.json: "programme" must be a list in [ ].
config.empty: config_starter.json does not list any program.
config.notfound:
None of these programs is next to the starter or in its subfolder "app":

%s

Copy the starter next to the program or one folder above it, or enter the right EXE in config_starter.json.
program.format: config_starter.json, program %s: the entry must be enclosed in { }.
program.exe: config_starter.json, program %s: "exe" is missing or empty.
program.notexe: config_starter.json, program %s: "%s" is not an .exe file. The starter only starts .exe files.
program.parameter: config_starter.json, program %s: "parameter" must be a list of texts, e.g. ["--datadir", "profile"].
program.placeholder: config_starter.json, program %s: placeholder "%s" is unknown. Allowed are {ordner} (starter folder), {daten} (data folder) and {app} (program files).
program.before: config_starter.json, program %s: "vorher" must be a list in [ ].
program.wait: config_starter.json, program %s: "warten" must be a number from 0 to 60 (seconds).
program.missing: config_starter.json, program %s: "%s" is missing from the program folder.
program.self: config_starter.json, program %s: the starter cannot start itself.
